frontmatter_raw:
name: android-app-factory
description: "Suede AI Android App Factory Skills. Use when asked to \"build an Android app\" or modernize a Kotlin/Compose product: architecture, policy, privacy, billing, tests and a Play-ready release evidence package. NOT FOR: Play uploads or rollout (suede-play-release), website-to-iOS conversion (site-to-ios-app), review-only work (suede-code), or store listing strategy (suede-aso)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Android App Factory Skills"

name: site-to-ios-app
description: "Suede AI Site to iOS App Skills. Use when asked to \"turn this site into an iOS app\" or convert a PWA: inspect the URL, choose shell or native strategy, then deliver an audit, build plan and release evidence. NOT FOR: Android builds (android-app-factory), Play rollout (suede-play-release), store listing strategy (suede-aso), or a native iOS app with no website."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Site to iOS App Skills"

name: suede-ab-testing
description: "Suede AI A/B Testing Skills. Use when asked to \"design an A/B test\", compare variants, assess reliability, or build an experiment backlog: hypothesis, power, duration, guardrails and a predeclared decision rule. NOT FOR: instrumentation (suede-analytics), funnel diagnosis (suede-site-alchemy), variant copy (suede-copy), or channel incrementality (suede-attribution)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI A/B Testing Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-ad-creative
description: "Suede AI Ad Creative Skills. Use when asked to \"write Google ad variants\" or iterate hooks, headlines, RSA/PMax assets, static or motion concepts from product and performance evidence. Returns grounded variants and a limit-checked review package. NOT FOR: budgets/targeting (suede-ads), experiment design (suede-ab-testing), organic posts (suede-social), general imagery (suede-image), or landing copy (suede-copy)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Ad Creative Skills"
  version: 2.9.1

name: suede-ads
description: "Suede AI Ads Skills. Use when planning paid acquisition and asked to \"audit our paid campaigns\" or choose channels, structure campaigns, set budget pacing, retargeting and kill-or-scale rules from verified unit economics and performance. NOT FOR: ad asset production (suede-ad-creative), tracking implementation (suede-analytics), attribution reconciliation (suede-attribution), or landing-page work (suede-site-alchemy)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Ads Skills"
  version: 2.3.1

name: suede-agent-teams
description: "Suede AI Agent Teams Skills. Use when asked to \"split this work across agents\" or run coordinated shared changes in lanes with exclusive file ownership, collision checks, worktrees, rollback plans and evidence handoffs; also supports bounded contribution programs. NOT FOR: one bundled code DAG (suede-graph-flo-xr), diff review (suede-code), CI wiring (suede-ci-gate), or choosing one skill (suede-workflow-skills)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Agent Teams Skills"

name: suede-ai-eval
description: "Suede AI Eval Skills. Use when asked to \"write evals for this AI feature\" or assess LLM, RAG, agent, classifier or generated-media behavior: AI-SPEC, failure rubric, executable cases, coverage and acceptance evidence. NOT FOR: implementation review (suede-code), wiring existing evals into CI (suede-ci-gate), or coordinating builder lanes (suede-agent-teams)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Eval Skills"

name: suede-ai-seo
description: "Suede AI Answer Engine Optimization Skills. Use when asked to \"improve our AI citations\" or optimize for ChatGPT/Perplexity: crawler policy, entity consistency, citation-ready pages, off-site evidence and prompt-panel measurement. NOT FOR: nine-lane technical SEO audits (suede-seo-audit), quick promotion grades (suede-visibility-grader), or funnel implementation (suede-site-alchemy)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Answer Engine Optimization Skills"
  version: 3.0.1

name: suede-analytics
description: "Suede AI Analytics Skills. Use when asked to \"fix our analytics events\" or set up GA4/GTM, key events, consent, UTMs and search/AI channels with readback proof. NOT FOR: experiment decisions (suede-ab-testing), campaign optimization (suede-ads), attribution reconciliation (suede-attribution), or revenue operations (suede-revops)."

  display-name: "Suede AI Analytics Skills"

name: suede-aso

NOT FOR: app builds (android-app-factory or site-to-ios-app), release rollout (suede-play-release), paid assets (suede-ad-creative), or install instrumentation (suede-analytics)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI App Store Optimization Skills"
  version: 2.0.1

name: suede-attribution

metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Attribution Skills"
  version: 1.2.0

name: suede-campaign-in-a-box
description: "Suede AI Campaign in a Box Skills. NOT FOR: isolated copy (suede-copy), sync packages (suede-sync-packaging), rights resolution (suede-rights-passport), or software releases (suede-launch-packaging)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Campaign in a Box Skills"
  version: 1.0.0

name: suede-churn-prevention
description: "Suede AI Churn Prevention Skills. Use when asked to \"reduce subscription churn\" or design cancel flows, reason-matched save offers, failed-payment recovery and win-back measurement. NOT FOR: lifecycle email copy (suede-emails), pricing architecture (suede-pricing), paywalls (suede-paywalls), or tracking implementation (suede-analytics)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Churn Prevention Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-ci-gate
description: "Suede AI CI Gate Skills. Use when asked to \"fix a required check stuck pending\" or set up branch protection and path-aware CI, runtime/lockfile pinning and one aggregator gate from the real repository. Returns workflows and settings. NOT FOR: reviewing implementation (suede-code), designing AI evals (suede-ai-eval), or release packaging (suede-launch-packaging)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI CI Gate Skills"

name: suede-clip-to-guide
description: "Suede AI Clip to Guide Skills. Use when creating short-to-long content and asked to \"turn this clip into a guide funnel\": select a rights-supported moment, score fit, draft the bridge, approval bundle and measurement plan. NOT FOR: rendering (suede-video), social calendars (suede-social), full guide writing (suede-copy), paid ads (suede-ad-creative), or publication without exact-content and identity approval."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Clip to Guide Skills"
  version: 1.1.0

name: suede-co-marketing
description: "Suede AI Co-Marketing Skills. Use when asked to \"find co-marketing partners\" or plan a joint campaign: evidence-backed fit, reciprocal value, format, roles, consent, shared KPIs and content. NOT FOR: affiliate/referral programs (suede-referrals), software release packaging (suede-launch-packaging), or partner-facing sales collateral (suede-sales-enablement)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Co-Marketing Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-code
description: "Use when explicitly asked \"review this PR\" or to grade a diff, branch, or commit range. Suede AI returns evidence-backed P0-P3 findings, fix paths and an A-F ship grade; supports findings-only, grade-only and fix modes, seven review lanes, security checks, deploy safety and commit dirt. NOT FOR: automatic CI enforcement (use suede-ci-gate), agent evaluations (use suede-ai-eval), implementation-plan search (use suede-graph-flo-xr), or parallel fix coordination (use suede-agent-teams)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Code Skills"

name: suede-cold-email
description: "Use when asked \"write a cold email\" or to repair B2B outbound to qualified prospects. Suede AI produces sourced personalization, short subjects, bodies under 75 words, one ask and bounded follow-ups, with current sender-rule checks. NOT FOR: prospect qualification (use suede-prospecting), opted-in lifecycle email (use suede-emails), or broader sales collateral (use suede-sales-enablement)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Cold Email Skills"
  version: 2.1.1

name: suede-community-marketing
description: "Use when asked \"plan our community launch\" or to audit or drive product community growth. Suede AI returns member identity, platform choice, a seeding plan, rituals, moderation paths, ambassador design and health metrics with denominators. NOT FOR: public social content (use suede-social), referral payouts (use suede-referrals), or customer interviews (use suede-customer-research)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Community Marketing Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-competitor-profiling
description: "Use when asked \"research these competitors\" or to refresh named competitor profiles. Suede AI competitive intelligence captures current public evidence for positioning, pricing, product, reviews, search and AI visibility, separating facts, inferences and unknowns. NOT FOR: publishing comparison pages (use suede-competitors), sales battle cards (use suede-sales-enablement), or pricing decisions (use suede-pricing)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Competitor Profiling Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-competitors
description: "Use when asked \"write a comparison page\" or to plan an alternative or versus page from verified competitor evidence. Suede AI returns evaluator-focused copy, fair comparisons, pricing context, migration guidance and search-ready structure. NOT FOR: gathering competitor evidence (use suede-competitor-profiling), internal battle cards (use suede-sales-enablement), or scaled page systems (use suede-programmatic-seo)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Competitor Comparison Skills"
  version: 2.0.1

name: suede-component-lab
description: "Use when asked \"stress test this component\", for a component workbench with reachable product states, or for stress fixtures and live variants of an existing UI component. Covers loading, empty, error, success, focus, disabled and permission scenarios. NOT FOR: whole-flow or UI diff review (use suede-design), mechanism explanations (use suede-interface-explain), funnel architecture (use suede-site-alchemy), or general correctness and payment review (use suede-code)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Component Lab Skills"

name: suede-content-strategy
description: "Use when asked \"plan our content strategy\" or to decide what to publish, refresh or stop. Suede AI maps audience questions, pillars, topic clusters, AI answer gaps and original-data assets to priorities, cadence, distribution and KPIs. NOT FOR: drafting an asset (use suede-copy), SEO audits (use suede-seo-audit), AI visibility measurement (use suede-ai-seo), or social production (use suede-social)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Content Strategy Skills"
  version: 2.0.1

name: suede-copy
description: "Use when asked \"rewrite this landing page\" or to write, sharpen or retune conversion copy, public explainers and agent-facing docs across surfaces. Suede AI applies voice, frameworks, labeled variants, answer-first SEO/AEO, evidence boundaries and a 70-point ship score. NOT FOR: a standalone anti-slop pass (use suede-deslop), high-stakes research orchestration (use suede-ship-copy), visual design (use suede-design), or scored SEO audits (use suede-seo-audit)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Copy Skills"

name: suede-customer-research
description: "Use when asked \"synthesize these interviews\" or to discover what a defined customer segment says, needs and resists. Suede AI analyzes transcripts, surveys, tickets, reviews and forums into traceable VOC quotes, jobs to be done, personas and buyer questions. NOT FOR: competitor-only profiling (use suede-competitor-profiling), final copy (use suede-copy), or unsupported product prioritization (use suede-product-marketing)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Customer Research Skills"
  version: 2.1.1

name: suede-design
description: "Use when asked \"review this UI diff\" or \"audit this flow\"; to design interface hierarchy, tokens, color, type, accessibility or a design system; run a whole-flow review; restyle a dashboard; or verify a visual build. NOT FOR: component state workbenches or live variants (use suede-component-lab), source-backed effect explanations (use suede-interface-explain), sales copy (use suede-copy), funnel architecture (use suede-site-alchemy), or general code/security review (use suede-code)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Design Skills"

name: suede-deslop
description: "Use when asked \"deslop this draft\" or to audit finished prose before shipping. Suede AI Slop Stop Skills removes filler, false agency, formulaic rhythm, chat residue and misplaced formatting while preserving voice and protected facts. Returns edited prose and a 50-point score, or findings only. NOT FOR: rewriting the argument (use suede-copy), research orchestration (use suede-ship-copy), authorship detection, or certifying facts."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Slop Stop Skills"

name: suede-directory-submissions
description: "Use when asked \"plan our directory submissions\" or to select and sequence startup, SaaS, AI, MCP, marketplace or review listings. Suede AI adapts truthful positioning, maintains entity consistency and tracks submission evidence and verified backlinks. NOT FOR: release packaging (use suede-launch-packaging), scaled destination pages (use suede-programmatic-seo), or AI visibility audits (use suede-ai-seo)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Directory Submissions Skills"
  version: 2.0.1

name: suede-emails
description: "Use when asked \"build a welcome email sequence\" or to design nurture, onboarding, win-back, post-purchase or trigger-based lifecycle email flows. Suede AI returns entry and exit criteria, timing, exact copy, sender-rule checks and a measurement plan. NOT FOR: cold outbound (use suede-cold-email), SMS (use suede-sms), in-product onboarding (use suede-onboarding), or broader lifecycle operations (use suede-revops)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Lifecycle Email Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-free-tools
description: "Use when asked \"scope a free calculator\" or to choose a lead, link, education or adoption tool tied to a paid product. Suede AI scores calculators, graders and generators, scopes an MVP and defines an indexable tool page, worked example, schema and KPIs. NOT FOR: downloads (use suede-lead-magnets), full-site implementation (use suede-site-alchemy), or search diagnostics (use suede-seo-audit)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Free Tools Skills"
  version: 2.0.0

name: suede-graph-flo-xr
description: "Use when asked \"compare implementation plans before building\" for one multi-file repository change. Suede AI runs Suede Thought Graph shipping search: it searches, scores, prunes and refutes plans, selects one winner, then builds in an isolated worktree with a sandboxed gate and handoff. Halts on hazards, collisions or exhausted budget. NOT FOR: bulk worker tasks, existing-diff review (use suede-code), CI wiring (use suede-ci-gate), or copy-only work (use suede-ship-copy)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Graph Flo XR Skills"

name: suede-image
description: "Use when asked \"create an Open Graph image\" or to produce marketing heroes, banners, social graphics, mockups or image workflows. Suede AI chooses generation, editing, templates or real screenshots, then specifies layout, rights, export sizes, compression and image SEO. NOT FOR: paid-ad systems (use suede-ad-creative), video (use suede-video), app-store assets (use suede-aso), or social strategy (use suede-social)."
metadata:
  display-name: "Suede AI Image Skills"
  version: 2.1.0

name: suede-influencer-outreach
description: "Use when asked \"pitch this creator\" or to repair an influencer or B2B creator-program first touch. Suede AI grounds one message in a named audience fact, states real compensation and one ask, fits the published contact route and stops the two-follow-up plan at a positive reply. NOT FOR: affiliate mechanics (use suede-referrals), brand partnerships (use suede-co-marketing), cold B2B email (use suede-cold-email), or journalist pitches (use suede-public-relations)."

  display-name: "Suede AI Influencer Outreach Skills"

name: suede-interface-explain
